linked_bills: SELECT id,bill_number,bill_date,bill_type,status,total_amount,paid_amount,balance_amount,total_refunded_amount FROM public.bills WHERE clinic_id='238307be-362b-4fff-bb9a-3f2f9ff44519' AND id IN (SELECT bill_id FROM public.payment_records WHERE clinic_id='238307be-362b-4fff-bb9a-3f2f9ff44519' AND payment_date>='2026-10-01 00:00:00+05:30' AND payment_date<transaction_timestamp()) ORDER BY bill_date
linked_refunds: SELECT id,bill_id,total_amount,status,created_at,paid_at FROM public.refund_requests WHERE clinic_id='238307be-362b-4fff-bb9a-3f2f9ff44519' AND id IN (SELECT refund_request_id FROM public.payment_records WHERE clinic_id='238307be-362b-4fff-bb9a-3f2f9ff44519' AND payment_date>='2026-10-01 00:00:00+05:30' AND payment_date<transaction_timestamp())
linked_bill_all_payments: SELECT bill_id,record_type,count(*) records,sum(amount) amount FROM public.payment_records WHERE clinic_id='238307be-362b-4fff-bb9a-3f2f9ff44519' AND bill_id IN (SELECT bill_id FROM public.payment_records WHERE clinic_id='238307be-362b-4fff-bb9a-3f2f9ff44519' AND payment_date>='2026-10-01 00:00:00+05:30' AND payment_date<transaction_timestamp()) GROUP BY bill_id,record_type
lims: SELECT id,visit_id,patient_id,external_order_id,status,tests_sent,matched_tests,unmatched_tests,pdf_received_at,created_at FROM public.lims_outbound_orders WHERE clinic_id='238307be-362b-4fff-bb9a-3f2f9ff44519' AND created_at>='2026-10-01 00:00:00+05:30' AND created_at<transaction_timestamp()
hims: SELECT id,visit_id,patient_id,external_order_id,status,matched_tests,unmatched_tests,created_at FROM public.hims_lab_orders WHERE clinic_id='238307be-362b-4fff-bb9a-3f2f9ff44519' AND created_at>='2026-10-01 00:00:00+05:30' AND created_at<transaction_timestamp()
stock_summary: SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_active) active_products,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_active AND current_stock>0) stocked_products,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_active AND current_stock<=coalesce(reorder_level,0)) at_or_below_reorder,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_active AND current_stock<0) negative_stock_products FROM public.medicines_master WHERE clinic_id='238307be-362b-4fff-bb9a-3f2f9ff44519'
expired_lots: SELECT count(*) lots,coalesce(sum(quantity),0) stock_quantity FROM public.medicine_batches WHERE clinic_id='238307be-362b-4fff-bb9a-3f2f9ff44519' AND quantity>0 AND expiry_date<'2026-10-30'
movements: SELECT movement_type,reference_type,count(*) records,min(movement_date) earliest,max(movement_date) latest FROM public.stock_movement_log WHERE clinic_id='238307be-362b-4fff-bb9a-3f2f9ff44519' AND movement_date>='2026-10-01 00:00:00+05:30' AND movement_date<transaction_timestamp() GROUP BY movement_type,reference_type
visit_reference_check: SELECT id,coalesce(visit_date,date) encounter_at FROM public.visits WHERE clinic_id='238307be-362b-4fff-bb9a-3f2f9ff44519' ORDER BY coalesce(visit_date,date)
